WITH rng AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS d0, DATE '2025-09-21' AS d1)
SELECT 'sales' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line, rng WHERE sale_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line, rng WHERE return_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1

SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH dup AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) rets
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, etl_loaded_at LIMIT 12

WITH dup AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) l, min(sale_date) dmin, max(sale_date) dmax FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT c, l, min(dmin), max(dmax), count(*) FROM dup GROUP BY 1,2

WITH rng AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS d0, DATE '2025-09-21' AS d1),
sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt, 1 AS dd
  FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key, rng
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 1
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key, rng
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(amt) net FROM lines GROUP BY 1),
raw AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) gross_raw FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key, rng
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1 AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) rpt_net, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, rng WHERE business_date BETWEEN d0 AND d1 AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.store_id, round(m.net,2) mine, rpt.rpt_net, round(m.net-rpt.rpt_net,2) diff, round(raw.gross_raw,2) raw_before_ret, rpt.rpt_gross
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN raw USING (store_id) ORDER BY abs(m.net-rpt.rpt_net) DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 25

WITH sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sales_dedup f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
),
store_sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1),
trading AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs
  CROSS JOIN dim_date d
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 AND d.is_trading_day
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id
                    AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading t USING (store_id)
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
